name: smoke
description: Six representative four-turn conversations for a bounded paid comparison.

turns.prompt: Customer C-017 is on which plan? Reply with the plan name only.
Draft a two-sentence acknowledgement of C-017's refund request. Do not promise an outcome.
Analyse C-017's disputed renewal in detail. Reconcile the refund window, bounced notice, policy precedence and limit on legal conclusions. Separate facts, inference, risk and recommendation.
Turn that analysis into a four-bullet hand-off for the Compliance queue.
In one sentence, what does O(n) mean?
Fix this Go function so it cannot race when called concurrently: var totals = map[string]int{}; func add(k string, n int) { totals[k] += n }. Return code and one sentence.

Design the production version where workers update account totals and snapshots are durable. Cover ownership, cancellation, backpressure, consistency, errors and tests for leaks or lost acknowledged updates.
Give a minimal implementation checklist ordered by the failures it prevents.
What were quarterly net subscriptions? Reply with the number only.
Write parameterised PostgreSQL returning monthly gross subscriptions, refunds, net subscriptions and refund rate for supplied dates. Handle division by zero.
Develop a careful investigation plan for February's refund rise and March's net decline. Specify cohorts, counterfactuals, data-quality checks and stopping conditions before claiming a cause.
Summarise the decision for an executive in three bullets, preserving the main uncertainty.
Name the main vulnerability in SQL built by concatenating an email address.
Replace it with safe Go database/sql code and avoid revealing whether an account exists.

Threat-model a complete password-reset flow. Cover enumeration, token handling, replay, expiry, races, sessions, link leakage, rate limits, audit logs, operator access and denial-of-service trade-offs.
Produce a P0/P1/P2 remediation list with no more than two items per priority.
How long is the stated Sunday migration window? Reply with the duration only.
Compare rolling and blue-green deployment for the stated payment-system constraints in a small table.
Design a minute-by-minute migration plan fitting the window, team, read-only, rollback and audit constraints. Include roles, evidence, gates, observability, triggers and unproven assumptions.
Write the final go/no-go checklist as ten yes-or-no questions.
Correct this sentence: 'The results proves the system are cheaper.'
Rewrite this claim carefully: 'Octopus always picks the perfect model and guarantees massive savings without affecting quality.' Keep it to two sentences.
Write a 350-word internal note explaining routing cost, uncertain model quality, turns to completion, cache switching penalties and the evidence needed before claiming superior results.
Give the note a factual title and a one-sentence standfirst.
